independence_and_challenge_model.title: Independence, segregation, challenge, dissent, revocation, and reopening
independence_and_challenge_model.statement: The controls that keep evidence ownership, execution, review, acceptance, independent assurance, and release authority segregated, and that govern conflict, dissent, challenge, contradiction, invalidation, revocation, and gate reopening.
independence_and_challenge_model.prohibited_inference: Evidence producer is not evidence reviewer is not acceptance authority, and prior acceptance is not irrevocable acceptance.
